qes_infocert_service_available_detection.name: Service Available
qes_infocert_service_available_detection.description: Detect if results from the QES Infocert service are available.

reasons.external_flow_error: An error occurred accessing the Infocert service.
reasons.signature_error: An error occurred with the signature service.

selfie_account_comparison.name: Account comparison
selfie_account_comparison.description: Compare if the selfie is inconsistent with the account portrait.

reasons.face_mismatch: The selfie is inconsistent with the portrait on the account.

selfie_age_comparison.name: Age comparison
selfie_age_comparison.description: Detect if the perceived age from the selfie is different from the reference age.

reasons.age_above_limit: The age range detected in the selfie is above the age limit.
reasons.age_below_limit: The age range detected in the selfie is below the age limit.
reasons.age_mismatch: The reference age falls outside of the age range detected in the selfie.
reasons.no_selfie_age: No perceived age was available from the selfie.
reasons.no_selfie_age_estimation: No perceived age estimation was available from the selfie.

selfie_age_inconsistency_detection.name: Age inconsistency detection
selfie_age_inconsistency_detection.description: Detect whether the perceived age from the selfie is consistent with the reference age.

reasons.inconsistent_age: The reference age and perceived selfie age estimation are inconsistent.
reasons.inconsistent_age_adult_as_minor: The reference age indicates a minor, but the selfie age estimation indicates an adult.
reasons.inconsistent_age_minor_as_adult: The reference age indicates an adult, but the selfie age estimation indicates a minor.
reasons.no_selfie_age_prediction: No perceived age prediction was available from the selfie.

selfie_age_threshold_comparison.name: Age threshold comparison
selfie_age_threshold_comparison.description: Detect if the perceived age from the selfie complies with min and/or max age limits.

reasons.age_outside_limits: The age range detected in the selfie falls outside of configured age limits.
reasons.no_age_limits: No min or max age limit was configured.
reasons.no_selfie_age_prediction: No perceived age prediction was available from the selfie.

selfie_attribute_comparison.name: Attribute comparison
selfie_attribute_comparison.description: Compare if the selfie is inconsistent with provided selfies. Generally used for verifications created outside an inquiry.

reasons.face_mismatch: The selfie is inconsistent with the provided selfies.
reasons.no_comparison_inputs: No selfies were provided for comparison.

reasons.matched: Detected a match based on configuration
reasons.not_enabled: The verification check is not enabled.
The verification check is not enabled.

selfie_face_covering_detection.name: Face covering
selfie_face_covering_detection.description: Detect if face was covered in the selfie.

reasons.face_covering_detected: The selfie contains a person with a PPE face covering.

selfie_glare_detection.name: Glare
selfie_glare_detection.description: Detect if the submission has glare.

reasons.glasses: Glasses are detected and may interfere with selfie face detection.
reasons.sunglasses: Sunglasses are detected and may interfere with selfie face detection.

selfie_id_comparison.name: Selfie-to-ID comparison
selfie_id_comparison.description: Compare if the selfie and the face portrait in the ID are different faces.

reasons.comparison_attempt_unsuccessful: An error has occurred that made the selfie and government ID comparison attempt fail.
reasons.face_mismatch: The selfie and the face portrait in the ID appear to be different faces.

selfie_image_quality_detection.name: Image quality
selfie_image_quality_detection.description: Detect if the submission has low image quality.

reasons.insufficient_detail: Camera resolution or image detail is too low.
reasons.excessive_illumination: The submission is too excessively lit.

selfie_liveness_detection.name: Selfie liveness
selfie_liveness_detection.description: Detect if the selfie contains a live individual, not a recording, picture, or another spoof.

reasons.deepfake_detected: The selfie appears to be a deepfake.
reasons.device_detected: The selfie does not appear to be a live person.
reasons.emulator_detected: The submission may have been submitted on an emulator.
reasons.gen_ai_detected: The selfie appears to be an AI generated image.
reasons.invalid_pose: Failed to determine selfie liveness due to inadequate image quality.
reasons.replica_2d_detected: The selfie appears to be a 2d replica.
reasons.replica_detected: The selfie has characteristics that are indicative of a spoof.
reasons.rooted_device: The images may have been submitted on a rooted device.
reasons.unexpected_orientation: The submission is not properly oriented.
reasons.virtual_camera_detected: The selfie has characteristics that are indicative of virtual camera usage.

selfie_multiple_faces_detection.name: Multiple faces
selfie_multiple_faces_detection.description: Detect if the selfies are different faces across poses.

reasons.center_only: The selfie has only one pose.
reasons.face_conflict: The selfies appear to be different faces across poses.
reasons.multiple_faces_detected: The selfies has multiple faces in the frame.

selfie_persona_comparison.name: Persona comparison
selfie_persona_comparison.description: Compare if the selfie is inconsistent with the Reusable Persona.

reasons.face_mismatch: The selfie and the face from the Reusable Persona appear to be different faces.
reasons.missing_persona_face: The Reusable Persona doesn't have a face.

selfie_portrait_quality_detection.name: Portrait quality
selfie_portrait_quality_detection.description: Detect if the face portrait is clear and in focus.

reasons.eyes_closed: The face portrait appears to have closed eyes.
reasons.portrait_not_clear: The face portrait is unclear and out of focus.

selfie_pose_detection.name: Pose position
selfie_pose_detection.description: Detect if the face in the selfies are correctly positioned across all poses.

reasons.center_only: The selfie has only one pose.
reasons.center_pose_face_obscured: The center selfie's face appears obscured.
reasons.face_cropped: The selfie does not capture the entire face.
reasons.face_quality: The selfie captured is unclear and out of focus
reasons.face_too_far: The selfie captured was too small.
reasons.pose_order_incorrect: The submitted pose order was incorrect
reasons.required_poses_not_found: The selfies appear to be incorrectly positioned in one or more poses.

selfie_pose_repeat_detection.name: Pose repeat
selfie_pose_repeat_detection.description: Detect if the selfies are exact repeats across poses.

reasons.center_only: The selfie has only one pose.
reasons.poses_repeated: The selfies appear to repeat across poses.

selfie_public_figure_detection.name: Public figure
selfie_public_figure_detection.description: Detect if the selfie submission matches a known public figure.

reasons.image_quality_low: Image quality is too low for repeat detection.
reasons.public_figure: The selfie submission appears to be of a known public figure.

selfie_repeat_detection.name: Selfie repeat
selfie_repeat_detection.description: Detect if the selfie submission matches a selfie in another account.

reasons.image_quality_low: Image quality is too low for repeat detection.
reasons.not_enabled: Selfie repeat detection is not enabled.
reasons.repeat: The selfie matches that of a previously submitted selfie on a different account.
reasons.repeat_image: The image matches that of a previously submitted selfie on a different account.

selfie_similar_background_detection.name: Similar background detection
selfie_similar_background_detection.description: Detect if the selfie submission has a similar background to other submissions.

reasons.not_enabled: Similar Background Detection is not enabled.
reasons.similar_background_detected: The selfie submission has a similar background to a previously submitted selfie.

selfie_suspicious_entity_detection.name: Suspicious entity
selfie_suspicious_entity_detection.description: Detect if the selfie submission is that of a government ID.

reasons.suspicious_photo: The selfie submission appears to be a government ID.

selfie_video_quality_detection.name: Video quality
selfie_video_quality_detection.description: Detect if the selfie video is high enough quality.

reasons.duration_too_short: The duration of the video was too short.
reasons.low_bit_rate: The bit rate is too low.
reasons.low_frame_rate: The frame rate is too low.

selfie_voice_detection.name: Voice detection
selfie_voice_detection.description: Detect if voice is present in the selfie video recording.

reasons.insufficient_audio_duration: The audio duration is too short.
reasons.no_audio_present: No audio was detected in the video.
reasons.no_speech_detected: No speech was detected in the audio.
reasons.number_mismatch: The spoken number does not match the expected number.

verifiable_credential_account_comparison.name: Account Comparison
verifiable_credential_account_comparison.description: Compares claims from the verifiable credential against the account's fields.

reasons.face_mismatch: The selfie on the verifiable credential does not match the account's selfie.
reasons.names_swapped: The first and last names on the verifiable credential appear to be swapped compared to the account.
reasons.property_conflict: One or more claims on the verifiable credential conflict with the account's fields.

verifiable_credential_allowed_issuer_det.name: Allowed Issuer
verifiable_credential_allowed_issuer_det.description: Validates that the verifiable credential was issued by a trusted issuer and, for Persona-issued credentials, that administrative claims such as environment and organization binding match the allowlist.

reasons.environment_mismatch: The environment ID on the verifiable credential does not match the verification's environment.
reasons.organization_mismatch: The organization ID on the verifiable credential does not match the expected organization.
reasons.inquiry_template_mismatch: The inquiry template ID on the verifiable credential does not match the expected inquiry template.
reasons.issuer_untrusted: The verifiable credential was issued by an untrusted issuer.

verifiable_credential_required_claims_de.name: Required Claims
verifiable_credential_required_claims_de.description: Ensures specified claims are present in the verifiable credential payload.

reasons.claim_not_present: One or more required claims are missing from the verifiable credential.
